summary: Frustrated by build error due to missing claude-desktop package
detailed_context: Syg was attempting to build their NixOS configuration when the process failed with an error about an undefined variable 'claude-desktop'. The error occurred in the extra-programs.nix file where claude-desktop was listed as a package but wasn't available in the system's package set. Syg is frustrated because PAI failed to provide a solution for this missing dependency issue, leaving them stuck with a broken build. The specific behavior that triggered this reaction was PAI's inability to address the technical problem - instead of helping diagnose or suggest alternatives for the missing package, PAI just responded with the error message and nothing else. PAI should have either helped identify why claude-desktop wasn't available, suggested alternatives, or explained how to properly handle missing packages in NixOS configuration. This reveals Syg's expectation that PAI will help solve technical build issues rather than just report errors, showing they rely on PAI for practical troubleshooting assistance.
